name: Progressive Alliance for the Equal Future
description:
Another incarnation of the radical left, the Progressive Alliance for the Equal Future, advocates for progressive social policies and economic equality. 
    Their platform focuses on addressing issues of social injustice and gender equality. They propose comprehensive welfare programs, including universal free healthcare, cheap state-owned housing, and advocate for the rights of marginalized groups. 
    In international relations, they are against Matheuchellian hegemony viewing power of their corporations as the reason for injustice in the world.
